reviews.text: Excellent service, very well organized and very empathetic, I recommend it 100%.
The veterinary clinic is excellent.

We just started coming here and we are truly very happy to have such a good experience with a vet! The receptionist is always very friendly and the vet is also a very nice man, very calm and very knowledgeable, who gives precise advice to follow. They also care about Vincent, which is a small detail that changes everything. We will recommend this vet to many friends and fellow dog owners! Thank you for your kindness, peace of mind and the excellent care you give to our dog!
Very happy and grateful for the veterinary care at the clinic 😀 …
I took my dog ​​in without a consultation, because of a gland issue, and they attended to him very quickly and were very kind.

We took our sick kitten to La Salut. Both the administrative staff and Blanca, the veterinarian, treated us wonderfully.
They gave him a thorough check-up and blood work, which revealed a kidney problem.
They referred us to a 24-hour hospital for treatment.
During his stay at the hospital, the staff at La Salut inquired about our pet's progress, and Blanca, the veterinarian at La Salut, spoke with her counterpart at the hospital for our cat's well-being.
We are very grateful for the care we received and highly recommend this clinic, as they were incredibly professional.
Our kitten responded quickly to the treatment, and within 48 hours, we were ready to take him home to continue his recovery.
Thank you so much for everything.

Thank you so much for your review and for recommending us!

We are delighted to hear that your experience at Centre Veterinari La Salut was positive and that you especially appreciated our care for large animals.

Thank you for trusting us. We hope to see you again soon.

Marta
Owner – Centre Veterinari La Salut
Excellent service and willingness to address any questions about the procedures. My cat was neutered here, and everything went perfectly! Thank you!
I took my dog ​​in for a dental cleaning and found excellent professionals and even better people. The service was impeccable and the follow-up was outstanding. Thank you.
The service is excellent, fast and efficient; I would recommend them a thousand times over.
Trqcte and professionalism 10! We came to do an oral cleaning for Nina, a 10 year old greyhound and everything was perfect. The team is incredible💘 …
Very professional, and very personal and caring treatment.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

For us, talking about La Salud Veterinary Clinic means talking about over 25 years of trust and an important part of our family's life.

Luna, our cat, who sadly passed away from lung cancer, has been here; as has Kenny, our German Shepherd/Siberian Husky mix, who was with us for 15 and a half years; and currently Kira, a 9-year-old Mastiff/German Shepherd mix, and Shiro, our 7-year-old Golden Retriever. We've brought them all here practically since they were a few months old and have always trusted this clinic to care for them, through both good times and bad.

Over all these years, we've found something that, for me, is fundamental when you entrust a member of your family to someone: honesty, transparency, and professionalism. They have always been clear and direct when necessary, and sensitive and approachable when the situation called for it.

With the changes the clinic has undergone, first with Camilo's arrival and now with Blanca and Susanna, I've felt that this philosophy and this way of caring have remained. They are always attentive to the patient, but also to those of us on the other side, worrying about them. Medically, our experience has always been excellent.

And I can't fail to mention Carmen, who has been there for so many years and is now part of the clinic's history and, in a way, ours as well. I'm sending you a huge hug and thank you for always being there for everything.

Marta, I wish you all the luck in the world in this new stage and this new project. Those of us who have shared our lives with animals know perfectly well the mark they leave on us and how important they become.

After more than 25 years, I think few things speak more highly of a veterinary clinic than being able to say that, generation after generation of our animals, we have continued to trust the same people.

Thank you for taking care of them for so many years and for being there for us when it was time to say goodbye. ❤️🐾

The staff are fantastic, friendly, and make both pet and owner feel comfortable.
Highly recommended, great advice, and competitive pricing.

My name is Lola, and I want to tell you a little bit about the veterinary clinic here. I've been going there for 23 years now. I had my first dog for 17 years, and I always took him there until his last days. I've always been very happy, and I still am. Now I take my second furry friend, who's about to turn 5. They did a neutering and a dental cleaning at the same time to make the most of the anesthesia, and I'm very pleased. My son and I are thrilled. The dog is doing great, the service is excellent, the professionalism is top-notch, and I highly recommend them. It's worth it. If I have any questions, anything I want to ask, I call or send a WhatsApp message, and they answer right away. They always support me, and my dog ​​loves going there. 🙏 Cleanliness, professionalism, and a human touch—I have no words to express my gratitude to this clinic. 🙏

We went to have our little Lilith spayed, and the service was excellent. They were very attentive and provided great follow-up on her recovery.
We will definitely return if we need any services.

Never before have I or my dogs been treated with such compassion and professionalism at a veterinary clinic. They made me feel like they weren't after my money, but rather my well-being and ensuring everything went perfectly for my pet. It was a wonderful experience both times I took my two Chihuahuas there. They never tried to overcharge me for anything and even checked on my dogs' condition for days afterward. Please never change. Thank you.

The staff are lovely; they make you feel very comfortable from the moment you arrive. They took care of my kitten as if she were their own.
The operation went very well, and they've been incredibly attentive to her recovery.
I'm very happy with the clinic. 100% recommended.

I took my dog ​​Risa to the clinic to be spayed. They were not only incredibly kind to her and to me (I was a little nervous), but they also contacted us several times after the procedure to check on her recovery. I highly recommend them; they are excellent professionals.

Excellent dental hygiene.
They were very attentive to the dog.

One of the best veterinary clinics in Barcelona, ​​with highly skilled and trustworthy professionals. We took our 7-month-old Golden Retriever, Tina, for spaying, and everything went wonderfully. Tina is thrilled! After the operation, she comes into the examination room as happy as ever. Many thanks to the entire team.

The staff were incredibly sweet and attentive. They took excellent care of my cat during her spaying and followed up for several weeks afterward. They also responded very quickly when I was worried about her exposure to pollen. I highly recommend them! 🩷🐱 …

Thank you very much for your review Pepa! 💙

We are happy to know that your experience with Ron has been positive. Thank you for trusting us! 🐾

— Marta
Owner · La Salut Veterinary Center
Everything was super professional and friendly, I took my cat to be neutered... super easy, here you have everything, happy.

Thank you, Patricia, for your positive review. Mini was wonderful, and you gave her a great post-operative care! That's the only way to see good results. 👌 You know where to find us for anything. 😸

— Marta
Owner · La Salut Veterinary Clinic
Always the best care for our dogs
It's a very good veterinary center, I recommend it.

There is nothing like the treatment received when our cat was spayed. Once again, thank you for the whole process. I have been taking cats and a dog to you all my life and there are already quite a few animals, I confirm that I am never wrong with you. Thank you, thank you for everything. You are very careful professionals and that is difficult to find these days.
We went this week to have our Pinscher, Kira, professionally cleaned. We couldn't be happier and more grateful for the service and the trust you inspire. Thank you so much, I recommend you 100%!
We had our cat Suricata spayed through a campaign, and the treatment, follow-up, attention, and care were excellent. Many thanks to the whole team!

We took our kitten Kenzo to be neutered, and the service was good and quick. In fact, we chose them because of their great reviews. Their concern is remarkable; even days later, they've inquired about Kenzo's condition. Thank you so much!
I am very happy, they are very professional and very kind. My dog ​​Masha adores them.

I took my kitten Leo to be neutered and the care was excellent. The vet, Camilo, explained the aftercare very well, since Leo had a special condition. All the staff were very friendly and they also followed up to check on his progress. Highly recommended!
They gave dental cleanings to two of my Yorkies, the service was excellent, from the reception staff to the vet himself, I recommend it 100%.

I took my two cats to be spayed, and overall, the care was good. One of them had no problems post-operatively and recovered very well.

With the other, we had a complication, as the wound reopened, and the healing process took longer than usual, requiring an Elizabethan collar for several weeks. I understand that the animal's behavior may have played a part, as she managed to remove the collar and lick herself at some point.

The clinic staff were very attentive. Anna monitored the cats' progress almost daily, and Camilo (one of the veterinarians) was very professional and kind, explaining how to proceed to ensure the wound closed properly. In the end, everything worked out well.

Overall, I appreciate their dedication, their friendly approach, and their personalized attention, although I'm not giving them the highest rating due to the difficulties we encountered in one of the cases.
Thank you Juan for that beautiful photo posing for the camera 😍😍 …

You get what you pay for! Despite being very far from where I live, we went to have our little kitten spayed. And it was a disaster. They operated on her on a Tuesday, and by Friday the wound started to smell awful. I called them at 4 pm and they didn't tell me until 7 pm to wash it with soap and water and to buy some ointment if it opened. At no point did they tell me to bring her in for a check-up. The next day the wound was completely open and smelled unbearable, and the kitten was very sick. Since they're closed on weekends, I took her to a clinic near my house, and they asked for the medical report to see what they had injected, and of course they didn't give me anything, just the receipt and the vaccination record with the date of the procedure. They stapled the wound. And they charged me a fortune for the visit and some medication for the inflammation and pain. She had a terrible weekend, poor thing.

On Monday I took her to the health center, Camilo (who treated us very well) examined her, removed the staples, and prescribed antibiotics. They charged us €25 for the antibiotics. The solution was to leave the wound open and let it heal by secondary intention.
I went to another vet, and they closed my kitten's wound, and she seems to be improving little by little. This vet told me that it's advisable to give cats antibiotics so they don't run any risks, although he mentioned that they've restricted the prescription of these medications. Mine has been very uncomfortable. And I've spent more than what they initially quoted me for the surgery. She's had to go to three different vets. And she's still wearing an Elizabethan collar and a post-operative bodysuit until all the tissue has healed properly. Bad experience, I won't be going back!!!
I had a terrible experience with them. My dog ​​died after surgery due to a surgeon's error (proven by autopsy), and they showed zero empathy. Please don't take your animals there!

Hello, Manoli.

We are sorry to see that your rating was not positive.

Since the review does not include any comments, it is not possible for us to know what happened or assess the situation.

From the current management of the La Salut Veterinary Center, we work every day to offer veterinary care based on professional rigor, proximity and transparent communication with families.

If you want to know our current project, you can do so at **www.lasalut.es**.

Warm regards.

**Marta**
**Owner – La Salut Veterinary Center**

Our Gru needed dental hygiene and finally they decided to do it at the La Salut Veterinary Center. We really couldn't be more satisfied! Seriousness with the schedules, impeccable treatment and a 10 result! And Gru is happy!!!
Very friendly. It was a pleasure serving you!
Good care for our cats and fair price. Highly recommended.

Our dental cleaning went really well. we received a full blood test result, we were informed about everything related to the cleaning itself
and a few hours later we picked up Marvel with perfectly clean teeth :)

Great experience overall, we will bring our second dog to La Salut in the future for sure
They are very professional when it comes to surgery. They performed mammary surgery on my dogs, gave them a dental cleaning, and everything was great. They are very animal-loving.
Very professional and a great experience taking my two cats to be neutered and microchipped. 100% recommended
Excellent clinic! My cat recently had surgery there and they were fantastic and very attentive. Thank you so much!
Everything was perfect! 100% recommended.
Good service

Very friendly and pleasant, we always come with Coco to have our teeth cleaned and they are super attentive. They explain the whole procedure before and after the intervention, they also explain the analysis and the values ​​that need to be monitored, in the days after the intervention they contact you to follow up and if you need anything you can contact them. We are very happy with this clinic, it gives us a lot of security. I attach a photo of Coco leaving the dental cleaning, still sleepy :)
